steps.text: An app is any program on your comptuer that you can run to perform a specific function. This includes File Explorer, a browser like Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome, text editors like Microsoft Word or Notepad, and more. There three main ways to open an app that we will explore in this lesson.

The first way you can open an app is through your taskbar, the row of app icons at the bottom of your screen. Open the File Explorer app by clicking on the folder icon in the taskbar. This will open a window that allows you to navigate through your files and folders.
Great job! Now click the 'X' in the top right corner of the File Explorer window to close it.

The next way you can open an app is by clicking on app icons on your desktop. If you have a shortcut to an app on your desktop, you can double click the icon to open it. Try opening File Explorer again by double clicking the folder icon on your desktop.
Perfect! Now close the File Explorer window again by clicking the 'X' in the top right corner.
The third way you can open an app is through the start menu. Click on the windows button in the taskbar at the bottom of your screen to open the start menu.

The start menu contains a list of all the apps on your computer. You can scroll through the list to find the app you want to open, or you can use the search bar at the top of the start menu to quickly find an app by typing its name. (Press Next to continue)
Try opening the File Explorer again by clicking on the folder icon in the start menu.
Awesome! Now close the File Explorer window one last time by clicking the 'X' in the top right corner.
Congratulations! You've learned how to open apps on your computer through the taskbar, desktop icons, and the start menu.
Start by opening the Notepad app by double-clicking the Desktop icon with "Notepad" under it.
The Notepad app is a basic text editor that lets you write and edit plain text. You can use it to take notes, write lists, or even write code!
Try clicking on the text area in the notepad app and typing some text in. The app has some example text to start, which you can also edit or delete.

In Notepad, as well as in many other apps like your web browser, you can click and drag across text to select it. Try it out by clicking and dragging across some text to see it outlined, then hit Next when you're done.

Now try highlighting some text and hitting Ctrl and C on your keyboard at the same time to copy the text. This saves a copy of the text to your clipboard, which is a special area of your computer's memory that can hold text or images that you've copied or cut.
Now try pressing Ctrl and V on your keyboard at the same time to paste the text. This pastes the text from your clipboard into the current document.

Now highlight some text and press Ctrl and X on your keyboard at the same time to cut the text. This removes the text from your document and saves it to your clipboard, so you can paste it somewhere else if you want.
Press Ctrl and V to paste the text you cut back into the notepad editor.

Good job! You've learned how to select text and use the copy, cut, and paste functions in Notepad. These functions work in many other apps as well, so you can use them to easily move or copy text around on your computer.
The file explorer allows you to see every file that you have on your computer. This includes applications, downloaded files, documents, and even system files. Start by opening the file explorer.
When you first open the app, you see the Quick Access menu. As you can see, it shows shortcuts to commonly accessed folders like Documents or Pictures.
Click on the Desktop folder on the left to go to the desktop folder.

In the desktop folder, you can see all the files that are on the desktop. Right now, it only has shortcuts to 3 apps, but you can place any files on the desktop and their icons will be easily accessible.
Now click on the Downloads folder on the left.

In the downloads folder, you can see all the files that you have downloaded to your computer. By default, most web browsers will save downloaded files to this folder, so it's a good place to check when you download something from the internet.
Now click on the Documents folder on the left.

In the documents folder, you can see all the files that you have created or saved in your Documents folder. This is a good place to keep your personal files like word documents, spreadsheets, and presentations.
Now click on the Pictures folder on the left.

In the pictures folder, you can see all the images that you have saved to your computer. This is the default location for screenshots, pictures uploaded from the phone, and pictures applications might save.
Now click on the Music folder on the left.
The music folder is where music is saved to your computer. If you download music or import it from a device, this is where it will be saved.
Now click on the Videos folder on the left.
The videos folder is where videos are saved to your computer. If you record something on your screen, this is where the default location for videos will be.
Now go back to the documents folder so we can try to create our own folder.
Click "New" in the top left, and then click "Folder" to create a new folder.

And that is the end of this lesson! You've learned how to navigate through the file explorer and find important folders on your computer. You also learned how to create a new folder to organize your files. Great job!
